video: What happens when you send a message to ChatGPT
note: One entry per scene. Status is the only field a steady-state session flips. Never reword or delete acceptance criteria to make a scene pass - that is a correctness bug, not a shortcut.

features.title: User types and sends a message
acceptance: Chat window is visible and fully inside the safe area for the whole scene
The question is typed character by character, not faded in whole
Sent text becomes a right-aligned user bubble and the composer empties
A typing indicator appears on the assistant side and holds
Scene renders at the test profile with exit code 0

features.title: The request leaves the device
acceptance: Client, internet hop and server are laid out left to right
Packets visibly travel along both links in sequence
The server rack reacts when the request arrives

features.title: The sentence is split into tokens
acceptance: Plain sentence visibly separates into discrete chips
The leading-space convention is explicitly called out on at least one token
At least one long word is shown splitting into multiple chips
Token ids are revealed after the chips exist, not at the same time
Everything stays inside the safe area at every beat
Scene renders at the test profile with exit code 0

features.title: Token ids become vectors
acceptance: A token id is shown indexing into an embedding table
The resulting vector is shown as a truncated column, not 1536 numbers
Similar words are shown landing near each other in 2-D

features.title: The stack of layers refines the representation
acceptance: Attention is shown as weighted links from one token to earlier tokens
The causal mask is visible - no token attends to its future
Activation sweeps bottom to top through the stack
The elided middle of the stack is obvious, not hidden

features.title: Logits become probabilities and one token is picked
acceptance: Bars are sorted descending and sum to one
Changing temperature visibly flattens and sharpens the same distribution
The sampled token is highlighted while the rest dim

features.title: The loop runs again, one token at a time
acceptance: The chosen token is appended to the input and the loop visibly repeats
At least three iterations play before cutting away
Tokens arrive in the chat bubble in the same order they were sampled

features.title: The finished answer lands back in the chat window
acceptance: The streamed answer is shown complete in an assistant bubble
A final pull-back shows every stage of the pipeline at once
The pipeline miniatures reuse the same components as their full scenes
